gold.user: A developer wants to retrieve the custom OIDC subject template for their organization to understand how it is configured and possibly make adjustments to their authentication flow.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current OIDC custom subject template for the specified organization, including any relevant details about its configuration.

gold.user: An administrator needs to update the OIDC custom subject template for their organization to include additional claims that are necessary for their CI/CD pipeline to function correctly.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the OIDC custom subject template for the specified organization and return a confirmation message along with the updated template details.
